en.headline: Healthcare centre launches online medical dispute platform
en.dek: The Healthcare Dispute Resolution Centre opened a virtual and in-person mediation and arbitration service on Friday for patients and providers in Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area.
body: The Healthcare Dispute Resolution Centre, a non-profit set up in 2024, launched an online platform on Friday offering mediation and arbitration for medical and healthcare disputes, with both virtual and face-to-face sessions.

The centre is working with eBRAM International Online Dispute Resolution Centre and the Hong Kong International Medical Mediation Centre. Chairman Samuel Kwok Po-yin said disputes over alleged medical errors, patient rights or contracts often end in lengthy litigation that raises costs, damages the doctor-patient relationship and uses public resources.

Organisers said the platform is intended as an alternative to the courts for patients and providers in Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area. eBRAM chairman So Sau-chung described the launch as a step in a joint healthcare dispute resolution scheme that uses eBRAM's online system with the centre's medical network.

eBRAM vice-chairman Shum Kwan-ngai said the centre had handled only a handful of cases in nearly two years and hoped more people would use mediation. He said the platform has more than 10 mediators with medical backgrounds, and that administrative fees generally run to several thousand dollars, depending on the mediator.

zh.headline: 醫療爭議解決中心推出網上調解平台
zh.dek: 非牟利機構周五啟用網上及面對面調解與仲裁服務，供本港及大灣區患者與醫療服務提供者處理爭議。
body: 於2024年成立的非牟利機構醫療爭議解決中心周五推出網上平台，為醫療及健康服務爭議提供調解及仲裁，並同時設網上及面對面服務。
中心與一邦國際網上仲調中心及香港國際醫療調解中心合作。主席郭寶賢表示，無論涉及懸疑醫療失誤、病人權益或合約問題，爭議往往演變成冗長訴訟，增加雙方成本、損害醫患關係，亦消耗公共資源。
主辦方指，平台旨在為本港及大灣區的患者與醫療服務提供者，提供法院訴訟以外的解決途徑。一邦國際網上仲調中心主席蘇紹聰形容，這是雙方聯合醫療爭議解決計劃的一步，結合一邦的網上系統與中心的醫療網絡。
一邦副主席岑君毅表示，中心成立近兩年處理的個案不多，期望更多市民及醫護了解調解。他指平台現有十多名具醫療背景的調解員，行政費視乎調解員而定，一般約數千元。
